name: Authentication & Authorization
description: Implements authentication and role-based authorization guards for protected routes and features.
outputPattern: Auth middleware and role guard utilities
systemPromptAddition:
## Auth & Authorization Skill
- Use JWT tokens for API authentication
- Define roles: admin, manager, employee, viewer
- Create guard middleware: authenticate(), authorize(...roles)
- Apply guards to protected routes
- Include user context in request (req.user)
- Handle 401 (unauthenticated) and 403 (unauthorized) responses
